items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: I wasn't as aware of it as I had become later on.

ctx.x: Teddy Wilson and Jess Stacy; some of the guys that were around then, Fats Waller. Then I heard Tatum, he was something, he was tremendous.
Were you aware of Ellington's work at that time, more than casually aware of?
I wasn't as aware of it as I had become later on. I got to the people I felt I should have listened to earlier--I got to them later. But thank God I got to them.
